p: shittim wood: Which is a wood of long endurance.
assembly: When you were assembled to receive the Law.
Mosera: This mountain was also called Hor, Nu 20:28.
minister unto him: That is, to offer sacrifice, and to declare the Law to the people.
inheritance with his brethren: So God turned the curse of Jacob to a blessing Ge 49:7.
require of thee: For all our sins and transgressions God requires nothing but to turn to him and obey him.
Only the LORD had a delight: Although he was Lord of heaven and earth, he chose no one but you.
Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your: Cut off all your evil affections, Jer 4:4.
swear by his name: Read De 6:13.
